_comment: One entry per labelled clip. session_id is the grouping unit for every
split and is NOT optional: grouping by clip still leaks instrument
identity and background, because several clips show the same bench.
container_frame_count must be a real probed value. The pipeline refuses
to guess, because the usual fallback silently samples only the opening
moment of every clip. Run scripts/extract_frames.py to fill these in.
